# CenterLinked

> One live organization referral link for behavioral-health and addiction-treatment BD teams. Not a patient directory.

CenterLinked is a B2B referral platform. Treatment organizations maintain a branded profile — facilities, levels of care, in-network insurance, and who to contact — and share one URL with professional referral partners.

It is invite-oriented and work-email gated. It does not store PHI, provide medical advice, or list programs for consumers searching for treatment.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and FAQ.
- [Pricing](/pricing): What is free, what membership includes, and how to cancel.
- [About](/about): What the product is for, and what it deliberately does not do.
- [Partners](/partners): List a program, or search if you place people.
- [Contact](/contact): Write the team about a listing or a membership question.
- [Login](/login): Sign in with a work email.
- [Signup](/signup): Create an account (work email required).
- [Request access](/request-access): Ask to join if you do not yet have an invite.
- [Privacy](/privacy) and [Terms](/terms).

## Who it is for, and who it is not for

For: behavioral health business development reps, treatment programs, multi-site treatment organizations, and professional referral sources (hospitals, employee assistance programs, interventionists).

Not for: patients or families looking for treatment on their own. Accounts require a work email, personal email domains are blocked unless approved, and the product stores no patient records, no charts, and no scheduling.

- [Insurance-fit search](/platform/search), [Program listings](/platform/listings), [Monthly verification](/platform/verification), [Contacts](/platform/contacts).

## Compared with the alternatives

- [vs SAMHSA Treatment Locator](/vs/samhsa-treatment-locator): SAMHSA lists licensed facilities and addresses. CenterLinked adds the named in-network contract, the date someone last confirmed it, and the business development contact.
- [vs payer provider directories](/vs/payer-directories): a payer directory answers for one carrier at a time and stops at the facility. CenterLinked searches payer, level of care, and city together and names the person to call.

## Notes

- [Insights index](/insights), covering insurance fit, monthly verification, and why a listing needs a person.

## Pricing

Claiming your organization and staying listed is free. Paid membership is optional and priced by how many live facilities you list: $99/month for 1 facility, stepping to $499/month for 15. Annual billing includes two months free. Optional Done For You setup is $499 / $1,200 / $2,500 by the same bands. 16+ facilities are quoted. Referral partners who only view a public profile are not billed. Team seats are unlimited.
